sloka: त्वामहम् सत्यमिच्छामि नानृतम् पुरुषर्षभ ।प्रत्यक्षम् तव सत्येन सुकृतेन च ते शपे ॥२-३४-४८॥
transliteration: tvāmaham satyamicchāmi nānṛtam puruṣarṣabha ।pratyakṣam tava satyena sukṛtena ca te śape ॥2-34-48॥

translations.english: I wish you, O best of men, to uphold truth and not falsehood. I swear this in your presence in the name of truth and on my merits acquired.
